annotations.title: US airport delays and ground stops

description:
Check US airport delays from the FAA's live National Airspace System status: ground stops, ground delay programs, arrival and departure delays (with minutes, trend and reason) and closures. Give an airport code, or none to list every airport with delays right now.

$0.003 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

When to use: You need to know if a US airport has delays or a ground stop right now.
Parameters: airport: a US code like JFK or KJFK; leave out to list every airport with delays.
Returns: ground stops, ground delay programs, arrival and departure delays (minutes, trend, reason) and closures, live from the FAA.

airport.description: US airport code, e.g. "JFK" or "KJFK". Leave out to list every airport with delays.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.
